verdict.rationale: A government e-services portal like e-FRRO could plausibly publish a public API, so this story applies. The evidence pack shows no documented public API at all. The probes only show a JavaScript-only web shell at the root and a 404 on the long-published entry path, which says nothing about programmatic access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
